在岛核前唤出第一只絮灵。: Call forth your first spirit at the Island Core.
用灯露邀请一只野生絮灵加入。: Invite a wild spirit to join you with Lantern Dew.
同时拥有 20 只絮灵。: Have 20 spirits at the same time.
图鉴里抓到全部 40 种形态。: Catch all 40 forms in the Codex.
让一只絮灵进化成成灵。: Evolve a spirit into an Adult.
让一只絮灵进化成云主形。: Evolve a spirit into its Lord Form.
在繁殖屋里生下第一枚蛋。: Lay your first egg in the Hatchery.
让两只属性相生的不同物种生下一枚蛋。: Breed an egg from two different species whose elements generate each other.
在净化池里净化一只蚀化的絮灵。: Purify a Blighted spirit in the Purifying Pool.
和朋友一起打赢一场战斗。: Win a battle together with a friend.
把岛核升到 5 级。: Upgrade the Island Core to level 5.
提灯和云舟都升到 5 级。: Upgrade both your lantern and skiff to level 5.
和一位守岛人的好感达到 4 级。: Reach Friendship level 4 with an Islekeeper.
浮岛的心脏。升级它，岛会长大。: The heart of the floating isle. Upgrade it, and the isle grows.
云舟停靠的地方。风帆商队的订单板也在这里。: Where skiffs moor. The Sail Caravan's order board is here too.
絮灵休息的小窝，每座住 4 只。家园岛上的絮灵恢复生命快一倍。: A cozy den for spirits; each holds 4. Spirits on your Home Isle recover HP twice as fast.
种下种子，絮灵会帮忙照料和收获。: Plant seeds, and spirits will help tend and harvest them.
把原料加工成面粉、木板、灯露……: Turns raw materials into flour, planks, Lantern Dew…
两只絮灵在这里生下絮灵蛋，蛋也在这里孵化。: Two spirits lay an egg here, and eggs hatch here too.
让蚀化的絮灵在这里静养 3 天，洗去暗色的雾。: Let a Blighted spirit rest here for 3 days to wash away the dark fog.
家园岛上的絮灵恢复生命快四倍；也让蛋孵得更快。: Spirits on your Home Isle recover HP four times as fast; eggs hatch faster too.
铺在地上的小路。: A little path laid on the ground.
絮灵喜欢在花坛边打盹。: Spirits love to nap beside the flowerbed.
曦冕的蚀光暗了一下，又更刺眼地亮了起来！: Dawncrown's blightlight dims for a moment, then flares even brighter!
曦冕发狂了，蚀光凝成了沉重的光锤！: Dawncrown goes berserk, its blightlight hardening into a heavy hammer of light!
灯塔会派我守在这里。想去塔下，得先让我看看你的絮灵。: The Lighthouse Order posted me here. Want to reach the tower? Show me your spirits first.
……好吧，你够格了。塔下那只，拜托你了。: …All right, you've earned it. The one beneath the tower—I'm counting on you.
还差一点。回去练练，我在这儿等你。: Not quite there. Go train a bit. I'll be waiting right here.
灯塔熄灭后，一只曦冕被蚀雾吞没，盘踞在晴原灯塔下。: When the lighthouse went dark, a Dawncrown was swallowed by the Blight and now lurks beneath the Sun Plains Lighthouse.
苍岚的翅膀卷起一阵黑色的旋风！: Azurehaze's wings whip up a black whirlwind!
苍岚发狂了，风里夹着碎石砸了下来！: Azurehaze goes berserk, and the wind hurls down shards of rock!
风谷的风会说话。你听得见吗？听得见，就来试试。: The winds of Wind Valley can speak. Can you hear them? If you can, come try me.
风停了。去吧，替我把灯点上。: The wind has stilled. Go on—light the lamp for me.
风还没站在你这边。下次再来。: The wind isn't on your side yet. Come back another time.
风谷的灯塔熄灭后，一只苍岚被蚀雾缠住，在塔顶盘旋不去。: When the Wind Valley lighthouse went dark, an Azurehaze tangled in the Blight began circling its top, refusing to leave.
碧泽搅起一片浑浊的潮水！: Jademarsh churns up a murky tide!
碧泽发狂了，整片沼泽都翻涌起来！: Jademarsh goes berserk, and the whole marsh heaves and surges!
雨泽的雨一下就是一个月。你等得起吗？: Once the rain starts in Rain Marsh, it lasts a month. Can you wait that long?
雨小了。……灯塔交给你。: The rain's easing. …The lighthouse is yours.
这点雨都扛不住，塔下那只你更打不过。: If you can't weather this drizzle, you'll never beat the one beneath the tower.
雨泽灯塔下的水塘里，一只碧泽被蚀雾泡成了黑色。: In the pond beneath the Rain Marsh Lighthouse, a Jademarsh has been soaked black by the Blight.
霆渊发狂了，整座崖都在打雷！: Abyssbolt goes berserk, and thunder rolls across the whole cliff!
雷崖上站得住的人不多。你是其中一个吗？: Few can keep their footing on the Thunder Cliffs. Are you one of them?
……打得好。雷声停了，去吧。: …Well fought. The thunder's quiet now. Go.
被雷劈一下就倒了？回去吧。: One lightning strike and you're down? Go home.
雷崖灯塔的避雷针被劈断了，一只霆渊盘在断针上，引来一道又一道黑色的雷。: The Thunder Cliffs Lighthouse's lightning rod was struck in two. An Abyssbolt coils on the broken spike, drawing down bolt after bolt of black lightning.
汐梦的触须在雾里散开，看不清它在哪！: Tidedream's tendrils spread through the fog—you can't tell where it is!
汐梦发狂了，雾浓得像一堵墙！: Tidedream goes berserk, and the fog grows as thick as a wall!
我在这片雾里守了很久，久到忘了自己的名字。让我看看，你能不能看清前面的路。: I've guarded this fog so long I've forgotten my own name. Show me whether you can see the road ahead.
雾散了一点。……最后一盏灯，拜托了。: The fog thins a little. …The last lamp—please.
你还看不清。等你看清了，再来找我。: You can't see clearly yet. Come find me when you can.
最后一座灯塔沉在雾海深处。一只汐梦把整座岛裹在梦一样的雾里。: The last lighthouse lies deep in the Mist Sea. A Tidedream has wrapped the whole isle in dreamlike fog.
离家最近的一座岛，坡上长满了野麦。: The isle closest to home, its slopes thick with wild wheat.
一条小溪从岛中间流过，岩缝里有雷铜矿。: A brook runs through the middle of the isle, and Thundercopper Ore hides in the rock cracks.
常年起雾的山谷。雾里有雾晶，也有蚀雾。: A valley wrapped in fog all year. The fog holds Mist Crystals—and the Blight.
守岛人阿禾的岛，一大片麦田。: Islekeeper Ah He's isle, one big sweep of wheat fields.
守岛人岚的岛，挂满了风铃，风一大就叮叮当当。: Islekeeper Lan's isle, hung with wind bells that jingle whenever the wind picks up.
一道朝南的长岭，坡上开满了向日葵。: A long south-facing ridge, its slopes covered in sunflowers.
岛上有座旧磨坊，风车早就不转了，只剩吱呀作响的木门。: An old mill stands here; its windmill stopped long ago, leaving only a creaking wooden door.
一弯浅浅的水湾，芦苇比人还高，风一吹就沙沙地响。: A shallow curve of water where reeds grow taller than people and rustle in the wind.
细长的山脊，风从两边同时吹来，站在上面要抓紧帽子。: A narrow ridge with wind from both sides at once—hold on to your hat up there.
开阔的草野，常有成群的鸢絮乘着上升气流盘旋。: Open grassland where flocks of Kitefluff often ride the rising air.
被山围住的深谷，喊一声能听见好几遍回音。: A deep canyon ringed by mountains. Shout once, and you'll hear it echo many times.
坡顶立着一排风车，有几架还在慢慢地转。: A row of windmills crowns the hill, a few still slowly turning.
风谷最高处的灯塔，塔顶盘旋着一团黑色的风。: The lighthouse on Wind Valley's highest point, with a knot of black wind circling its top.
满塘的荷叶，雨点落上去叮叮咚咚，像有人在敲小鼓。: A pond full of lotus leaves; raindrops plink on them like someone tapping a little drum.
长满青苔的沼地，踩上去软软的，一步一个脚印。: Mossy marshland, soft underfoot—every step leaves a print.
被芦苇围起来的小岛，里面藏着一片安静的草地。: A little isle ringed by reeds, hiding a quiet meadow inside.
一层层的石阶田，雨水顺着台阶一级级流下去。: Terraced stone fields where rainwater trickles down step by step.
终年下着细雨的海湾，雾气里能看见几座倒塌的木屋。: A bay of endless drizzle; through the mist you can spot a few collapsed wooden huts.
泡在水里的灯塔，塔下的水塘黑得看不见底。: A lighthouse sunk in water; the pond beneath it is too black to see the bottom.
满坡都是黑色的燧石，走在上面会擦出一点点火星。: A slope covered in black flint that throws off tiny sparks as you walk.
平顶的高台，雷雨天总有雷落在台中央。: A flat-topped mesa; in thunderstorms, lightning always strikes its center.
一块像铁砧的巨岩，敲一下会发出当的一声。: A huge anvil-shaped rock that rings with a clang when you knock on it.
海水拍上来时会闪出蓝白色的光，夜里尤其好看。: The waves flash blue-white as they break here—especially lovely at night.
雷崖最陡的山峰，峰顶的石头全被雷劈出了裂纹。: The steepest peak of the Thunder Cliffs; every stone on top is cracked by lightning.
立在崖边的灯塔，断掉的避雷针还在冒着电光。: A lighthouse on the cliff's edge, its broken lightning rod still crackling with sparks.
雾气像纱一样铺在浅滩上，走几步就看不清来路。: Fog lies over the shallows like a veil; a few steps in, you lose sight of the way back.
礁石围成的水湾里漂着成群的漂纱，一明一暗地发光。: A reef-ringed lagoon where swarms of Driftjelly drift, glowing on and off.
雾里的老树林，夜里能听见此起彼伏的鸮鸣。: An old forest in the fog, where owl calls rise and fall all night.
潮水涨落的声音很像有人在说梦话。: The ebb and flow of the tide sounds like someone talking in their sleep.
旧大地最后一座港口的残骸，码头上还系着一条空船。: The ruins of the Old Land's last port; an empty boat is still tied to the dock.
沉在雾海深处的最后一座灯塔。: The last lighthouse, sunk deep in the Mist Sea.
晴原东北角的小岛，太阳最早照到这里。: A little isle in the northeast corner of the Sun Plains, where the sun shines first.
一面长长的缓坡，坡顶总挂着几只风筝。: A long, gentle slope with a few kites always flying at the top.
岩缝里的风会吹出哨声，住在这儿的人从不缺音乐。: Wind whistles through the rock cracks; the folks here never lack for music.
一汪清塘边的小岛，雨天屋檐下总冒着热气。: A little isle beside a clear pond; on rainy days, steam always curls beneath the eaves.
雨泽的老渡口，栈桥比房子还长。: Rain Marsh's old ferry landing, where the pier is longer than the houses.
崖边凿出来的平台，夜里能看见炉火。: A platform carved into the cliff, where forge fires glow at night.
山坳里长满了晶石，打雷时会跟着一闪一闪。: A hollow full of crystals that flicker along with the thunder.
雾里的一弯小湾，沙滩上全是旧大地冲上来的东西。: A small cove in the fog, its beach strewn with things washed up from the Old Land.
雾海尽头的小岛，岛上的灯从来不灭。: A little isle at the edge of the Mist Sea, where the lights never go out.
浮岛上的树木，坚韧而轻。: Timber from the floating isles—tough yet light.
带着细纹的白色石头，据说是凝固的云。: White stone with fine veins, said to be solidified cloud.
雷雨过后在岩缝里闪光的矿石。: Ore that glints in rock cracks after a thunderstorm.
浓雾凝成的晶体，是提灯燃料的原料。: A crystal formed from thick fog; the raw material for Lantern Fuel.
晒饱了太阳的麦子。: Wheat that's soaked up plenty of sunshine.
雨后最甜的浆果，有点酸。: The sweetest berry after rain, with a little tartness.
风一吹就会叮当作响的果子。: A fruit that jingles whenever the wind blows.
种在田里，晴天长得快。: Plant in a field. Grows fast on sunny days.
种在田里，雨天长得快。: Plant in a field. Grows fast on rainy days.
种在田里，风天长得快。: Plant in a field. Grows fast on windy days.
风车磨出的细面粉。: Fine flour ground by the windmill.
刨得平整的木板，常用建材。: A smoothly planed board; a common building material.
絮灵最爱的点心，繁殖时需要。: A spirit's favorite snack. Needed for breeding.
热乎乎的包子，吃了立刻回满生命、解除所有异常。码头商队有卖。: A piping-hot bun that fully restores HP and cures all ailments. Sold by the caravan at the Dock.
进入有雾的岛时消耗。: Consumed when entering a foggy isle.
用来安抚野生絮灵、邀请它加入。: Used to calm a wild spirit and invite it to join you.
捕获成功率 ×2。商队不卖。: Catch rate ×2. Not sold by the caravan.
风停的时候，麦穗会轻轻碰在一起。有人在田埂上睡着了，草帽盖着脸。: When the wind dies down, the ears of wheat brush softly together. Someone's asleep on the field's edge, a straw hat over their face.
收成的日子，全村的人把麦捆堆成小山。孩子们从上面滑下来，满身都是金色的灰。: On harvest day, the whole village piles the sheaves into little hills. Kids slide down, covered in golden dust.
天亮之前，整片原野都在等。太阳出来的那一刻，露水一下子全亮了。: Before dawn, the whole plain is waiting. The moment the sun rises, every drop of dew lights up at once.
雨下了一整天。屋檐下摆着一排瓦罐，每个罐子接住的雨声都不一样。: It rained all day. A row of clay jars sits beneath the eaves, each catching a different sound of rain.
小镇的门口挂着铜铃。下雨时它不响，只是一滴一滴往下落水，像在数数。: A brass bell hangs at the town gate. In the rain it doesn't ring—it just drips, drop by drop, as if counting.
钟楼在雨季敲得特别慢。人们说，那是为了让远处河上的船也听得见。: In the rainy season the bell tower tolls extra slowly. People say it's so the boats far off on the river can hear.
风筝断了线，越飞越远。放风筝的孩子没有哭，只是一直挥手。: The kite's string snapped, and it flew farther and farther away. The child didn't cry—just kept waving.
大风从山口吹下来，整片原野像被一只手抚过。草帽飞走了，谁也追不上。: A great wind sweeps down from the pass, and the whole plain bends as if stroked by a hand. A straw hat flies off; no one can catch it.
候鸟每年秋天经过这里，从不停留。老人说，它们知道一条去南方的路。: Migrating birds pass by every autumn, never stopping. The old folks say they know a road to the south.
铁匠铺的炉火一夜不熄。火星从风箱口飞出来，落在地上，很久才暗下去。: The smithy's fire never goes out at night. Sparks fly from the bellows and land on the floor, fading only after a long while.
叮、叮、当。整条街都听得见。那是镇上唯一一个从来不迟到的声音。: Ting, ting, clang. The whole street can hear it—the one sound in town that's never late.
远处的雷光照亮了整座山，好一会儿才听见声音。大家数着秒，猜它有多远。: Distant lightning lights up the whole mountain; the sound comes a while later. Everyone counts the seconds to guess how far away it is.
清晨的厨房里，蒸笼一揭开，白气就涌满了屋子。谁也看不清谁，只听见笑声。: In the morning kitchen, the steamer lid comes off and white steam fills the room. No one can see anyone—only laughter.
天刚亮，湖上铺着一层薄雾。划船的人不说话，桨声很轻，怕把雾惊散了。: At first light, a thin mist lies on the lake. The rowers stay silent, oars soft, afraid to scatter it.
湖水静的时候，天空掉进了水里。有人说，看久了就分不清自己站在哪一边。: When the lake is still, the sky falls into the water. Some say if you stare long enough, you can't tell which side you're on.
院墙边种了一排向日葵，比孩子还高。每天傍晚，它们一起慢慢转过头去。: A row of sunflowers grows by the courtyard wall, taller than the children. Every evening, they slowly turn their heads together.
秋天把葵盘倒挂在屋檐下，一家人坐在门槛上剥瓜子，壳落了一地。: In autumn, sunflower heads hang upside down under the eaves. The family sits on the doorstep cracking seeds, shells everywhere.
最热的那一刻，田里没有一点影子。蝉叫得很响，好像太阳也会发出声音。: At the hottest moment, there's not a single shadow in the fields. The cicadas are so loud, it's as if the sun itself makes a sound.
折一根芦苇，削个口子就能吹响。声音哑哑的，像鸭子在叫，大家笑成一团。: Snap off a reed, cut a notch, and it'll play. It sounds hoarse, like a quacking duck, and everyone bursts out laughing.
牛在坡上吃草，放牛的人躺在草里吹哨。一支曲子吹到一半就睡着了。: The cows graze on the slope while the herder lies in the grass whistling, and falls asleep halfway through the tune.
对着山谷喊一声名字，山谷会慢慢地喊回来，一次比一次轻。: Call a name into the valley, and the valley slowly calls it back, softer each time.
夏夜开着灯，飞蛾一只一只撞在纱窗上。奶奶说，它们是来找月亮的。: On summer nights with the light on, moths bump against the screen one by one. Grandma says they've come looking for the moon.
风一吹，院子里的床单全鼓起来，像一排要起飞的帆。: When the wind blows, every sheet in the yard billows out like a row of sails about to take off.
爬到山顶的时候，云就在脚底下。风很大，大家拉着手，谁也没有说话。: At the summit, the clouds are right beneath your feet. The wind is strong; everyone holds hands, and no one speaks.
雨点落在荷叶上，滚成一颗颗水珠。青蛙蹲在叶子中间，一动也不动。: Raindrops land on the lotus leaves and roll into beads. A frog squats among them, perfectly still.
小船划进荷花深处，人就看不见了，只听见船桨拨开叶子的声音。: The little boat rows deep into the lotus and vanishes; all you hear is oars parting the leaves.
雨下了一整个月，衣服总也晒不干。可是那一年，稻子长得特别好。: It rained for a whole month, and the laundry never dried. But that year, the rice grew especially well.
老井的石头缝里长着青苔，凉丝丝的。打水的时候，桶会碰到井壁，咚的一声。: Moss grows cool in the cracks of the old well's stones. When you draw water, the bucket bumps the wall—thunk.
石桥上的青苔被人踩出一条小路。桥下的水很慢，倒影里的人也走得很慢。: Footsteps have worn a path through the moss on the stone bridge. The water below runs slow, and the people in its reflection walk slowly too.
两块石头一碰，就会跳出一点火星。孩子们在河滩上敲了一下午，手都震麻了。: Knock two stones together and a spark jumps out. The kids tapped away on the riverbank all afternoon until their hands went numb.
下山的路全是碎石，一不留神就会滑倒。走在前面的人总会回头说：踩我脚印。: The path down is all loose gravel; one slip and you'll fall. Whoever walks in front always looks back and says: step where I step.
那年夏天雷劈中了山顶的老松，烧了一夜。第二年春天，焦黑的地上冒出了新芽。: That summer, lightning struck the old pine on the peak and it burned all night. Next spring, new shoots sprang from the scorched earth.
退潮后的沙滩上，有东西一闪一闪地发着蓝光。走近了看，什么也没有。: On the beach after the tide goes out, something flickers with blue light. Up close, there's nothing there.
海上起了大风浪，灯塔的光一圈一圈扫过去。船上的人看见了，就知道家在哪边。: Big waves rose at sea, and the lighthouse beam swept around and around. The sailors saw it and knew which way was home.
据说海最深的地方没有一点光。可是渔夫们相信，那里住着会发光的鱼。: They say the deepest part of the sea has no light at all. But the fishers believe glowing fish live there.
午后的风把窗边的纱帘吹进屋里，又吸回去。屋里的光也跟着一明一暗。: The afternoon breeze blows the window's gauze curtain into the room, then draws it back. The light in the room flickers along with it.
母亲哼着一首没有词的歌，哼着哼着自己也打起了瞌睡。: A mother hums a song with no words, and as she hums, she starts to doze off herself.
晚上涨潮的声音很大，像有人在门外一遍遍地叫。第二天早上，沙滩又被抹得干干净净。: The evening tide is loud, like someone calling at the door again and again. By morning, the beach is wiped clean once more.
守夜的人坐在火边，听着林子里的猫头鹰。叫一声，他就添一根柴。: The night watchman sits by the fire, listening to the owls in the woods. Each time one hoots, he adds a stick.
夜深了，镇上的灯一盏一盏熄掉。最后亮着的，是钟楼上那一盏。: Late at night, the town's lights go out one by one. The last one still burning is up in the bell tower.
